messages.content: Return only JSON matching the schema. Audit category boundaries. Prefer existing carriers and the smallest executable circuit over new orchestration.

The Union's mathematical substrate admits opaque marks once, pairs a token mark with a claim mark as an Utterance, recursively articulates/predicates/posites it into FOUR-valued witnessed structure, and uses FCA derivation/closure, Hoare preservation, and distal-bypass obstruction classification to derive most answers. Finance already realizes an economic CommodityUtterance as an exact ordered (token, claim) payload, separate WitnessBitProduction, content-addressed finite trace and lot, local FOUR assay, customer effect, border-price offers, and replay-idempotent formation. Pymetrologic already supplies executable FCA, closure-rule, Chu, Hoare-adjacent, and settling algorithms. Existing free-compute-dev instead takes prose coding objectives, tries a tiny hand-coded resolver registry, then routes model tool actions through LISS; it learns via lexical overlap and JSONL trajectory counts. LISS properly owns cheapest-sufficient hosted model/device inference and Claude escalation, but currently treats all suppliers as language-model endpoints. EVM services already supply sovereign ERC-1271/EIP-712 enterprise accounts, mutually signed recursive Chu-Hoare effect cells, and an on-chain HolonomySeamLedger; x402 tollbooth exists but truthfully lacks broadcast. Constraint: the Union itself should be understood as an inference engine. Each unresolved need is a typed token/claim obligation. Existing deterministic derivations/services must be attempted first; only typed residue that cannot close deterministically is sold to an inference actuator service (free cloud/local GPU first, Claude when required). Returned claims require independent customer assay. EVM holds boundary authority, contracted seams, replay protection, receipts, and settlement commitments; JSON/Node are projections or adapters, not the authoritative market. No global work pool, coding-only scope, provider self-attestation, or monolithic distal-bypass artifact. Identify the smallest first executable circuit using these exact carriers, what should be retired or demoted from free-compute-dev, and the strongest category-error counterexample.
